text: Employees are eligible for annual leave according to company policy. They must submit a leave application to their manager before taking planned leave.
Employees can apply for sick leave when they are unwell. Medical certificates may be required for extended sick leave.
Leave applications must be reviewed and approved by the reporting manager. Employees should check their leave balance before applying.
The standard working hours are from 9 AM to 6 PM, Monday to Friday. Employees should follow the attendance policy.
Employees can request work from home with prior approval from their reporting manager.
Users can reset their account password by selecting forgot password on the login page and following the instructions sent to their registered email.
Users should use strong passwords and avoid sharing account credentials with other people.

Week 6 - Day 5 Embeddings + Vector Databases Concept Covered: Weekly Project - Semantic Document Search (Part 4): evaluation, README and demo Task - 1 Retrieval Evaluation Requirements • Create 20 evaluation queries with the expected source document and page • Compute hit rate at 1, 3 and 5 and the mean reciprocal rank (MRR) • Try a second chunk size or embedding model and compare the metrics • Analyse the 3 worst queries and decide whether the fix is chunking, embedding or metadata • Record everything in an experiment table Expected Output Config A: hit@3 0.80, MRR 0.67 | Config B: hit@3 0.90, MRR 0.74 (example) Concepts: retrieval evaluation, hit rate, MRR, experiments Task - 2 README and Demo Requirements • Write the README: architecture diagram, setup, how to index, API examples, evaluation results, limitations • Open a Pull Request and merge after review • Present a 5-minute demo: index a new document, search it, show filters and the evaluation table • Prepare for 'Why do some results look unrelated?' and 'How do you update documents?' Submission Submit the repo link, merged PR and present to the trainer. Concepts: documentation, demo, explaining retrieval quality Bonus Challenge Add a simple web page with a search box and highlighted snippets.
